name: OpenRouter
author: DJLegends
description: A kind of connection for OpenRouter's unified API, beside the app's OpenAI-compatible one: pick "OpenRouter" as a connection's kind and give it your OpenRouter API key. Sends reasoning effort via OpenRouter's reasoning object, surfaces upstream provider errors and model vision/context metadata, and lets you configure provider routing (sorting, preferred or ignored providers, fallbacks, data policy and ZDR).
